title: NetFlow | Top Talkers
description: Top IPs, conversations, applications and protocols. Raw-flow panels are capped to the latest 24 h. Use the Source/Dest IP variables (or click an IP) to investigate one host.

list.query: SELECT arrayJoin([${device:singlequote}]) AS e UNION DISTINCT SELECT DISTINCT ExporterName AS e FROM default.flows_1h0m0s WHERE TimeReceived > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND position('${site:csv}', '.*') > 0 AND position('${device_group:csv}', '.*') > 0 AND arraySort([${device:singlequote}]) = arraySort([${site_hosts:singlequote}]) ORDER BY 1

list.label: Direction
list.query: All : all,External → Internal : inbound,Internal → External : outbound,External → External : transit,Unclassified : unclassified
list.description: Derived from verified interface boundary metadata; never guessed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(Bytes*SamplingRate)*8/greatest(1, toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp($__fromTime)) AS bps FROM default.${res} WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${interface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${interface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}'))

SELECT sum(Bytes*SamplingRate) FROM default.${res} WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${interface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${interface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}'))

SELECT sum(Packets*SamplingRate) FROM default.${res} WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${interface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${interface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}'))

SELECT count() FROM default.flows WHERE TimeReceived >= greatest($__fromTime, now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AND TimeReceived <= $__toTime AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${interface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${interface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}')) AND ('${src_ip}'='' OR replaceRegexpOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '^::ffff:', '')='${src_ip}') AND ('${dst_ip}'='' OR replaceRegexpOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '^::ffff:', '')='${dst_ip}')

panels.title: FLOW COLLECTION

targets.rawSql:
SELECT multiIf(countIf(Status = 'ACTIVE') > 0, 2, countIf(Status = 'IDLE / NO RECENT FLOWS') > 0, 1, 0) FROM (SELECT l.exporter AS Exporter,
  multiIf(r.ex = '', 'NO DATA', x.ex != '', 'ACTIVE', 'IDLE / NO RECENT FLOWS') AS Status,
  if(has([${device:singlequote}], l.exporter), 'Configured', 'NOT IN INVENTORY') AS Inventory,
  if(x.ex != '', x.bps, 0) AS Traffic, if(x.ex != '', x.fps, 0) AS `Flows/s`, if(r.ex = '', NULL, if(x.ex != '', x.age, r.age)) AS `Last flow`
  FROM (SELECT arrayJoin([${exporter:singlequote}]) AS exporter) AS l
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT ExporterName AS ex, dateDiff('second', max(TimeReceived), now()) AS age FROM default.flows_1m0s WHERE TimeReceived > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') GROUP BY ex) AS r ON l.exporter = r.ex
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT ExporterName AS ex, sum(Bytes*SamplingRate)*8/300 AS bps, count()/300 AS fps, dateDiff('second', max(TimeReceived), now()) AS age FROM default.flows WHERE TimeReceived > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') GROUP BY ex) AS x ON l.exporter = x.ex)

panels.description: RECEIVING FLOWS = at least one exporter sent flows in the last 5 minutes. IDLE = exporters seen in the last 7 days, none in the last 5 minutes. NO FLOW DATA = no exporter has sent flows in 7 days (expected in a lab without traffic). Neither is an outage: router availability is on the Device Health dashboard.

panels.description: Time since the newest flow record in the selected data scope (raw table, last 24 h). "No flows in 24 h" = nothing was received; it does not say a device is down.

panels.title: Top source IPs

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ipaddr AS IP, nm AS Network, round(bytes*8/greatest(1, toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp(greatest($__fromTime, now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR)))) AS Traffic, round(100*bytes/sum(bytes) OVER (), 1) AS Share FROM (
     SELECT replaceRegexpOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '^::ffff:', '') AS ipaddr, if(any(SrcNetName) = '', '—', any(SrcNetName)) AS nm, sum(Bytes*SamplingRate) AS bytes
     FROM default.flows WHERE TimeReceived >= greatest($__fromTime, now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AND TimeReceived <= $__toTime AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${interface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${interface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}')) AND ('${src_ip}'='' OR replaceRegexpOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '^::ffff:', '')='${src_ip}') AND ('${dst_ip}'='' OR replaceRegexpOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '^::ffff:', '')='${dst_ip}') GROUP BY ipaddr)
   ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 8

panels.title: Top applications / ports

targets.rawSql:
SELECT app AS Application, round(bytes*8/greatest(1, toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp(greatest($__fromTime, now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR)))) AS Traffic, round(100*bytes/sum(bytes) OVER (), 1) AS Share FROM (
     SELECT concat(multiIf(Proto=6,'TCP',Proto=17,'UDP',Proto=1,'ICMP',concat('proto ',toString(Proto))), '/', toString(DstPort), if(transform(DstPort, [22,23,25,53,67,80,110,123,143,161,162,179,389,443,445,514,993,995,1194,3306,3389,5001,5060,8080,8443], ['SSH','Telnet','SMTP','DNS','DHCP','HTTP','POP3','NTP','IMAP','SNMP','SNMP trap','BGP','LDAP','HTTPS','SMB','Syslog','IMAPS','POP3S','OpenVPN','MySQL','RDP','iperf','SIP','HTTP-alt','HTTPS-alt'], '') = '', '', concat(' (', transform(DstPort, [22,23,25,53,67,80,110,123,143,161,162,179,389,443,445,514,993,995,1194,3306,3389,5001,5060,8080,8443], ['SSH','Telnet','SMTP','DNS','DHCP','HTTP','POP3','NTP','IMAP','SNMP','SNMP trap','BGP','LDAP','HTTPS','SMB','Syslog','IMAPS','POP3S','OpenVPN','MySQL','RDP','iperf','SIP','HTTP-alt','HTTPS-alt'], ''), ')'))) AS app, sum(Bytes*SamplingRate) AS bytes FROM default.flows
     WHERE TimeReceived >= greatest($__fromTime, now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AND TimeReceived <= $__toTime AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${interface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${interface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}')) AND ('${src_ip}'='' OR replaceRegexpOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '^::ffff:', '')='${src_ip}') AND ('${dst_ip}'='' OR replaceRegexpOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '^::ffff:', '')='${dst_ip}') AND DstPort > 0 GROUP BY app)
   ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 8

targets.rawSql:
SELECT conv AS Conversation, app AS Service, round(bytes*8/greatest(1, toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp(greatest($__fromTime, now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR)))) AS Traffic, round(100*bytes/sum(bytes) OVER (), 1) AS Share FROM (
     SELECT concat(replaceRegexpOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '^::ffff:', ''), ' → ', replaceRegexpOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '^::ffff:', '')) AS conv, concat(multiIf(Proto=6,'TCP',Proto=17,'UDP',Proto=1,'ICMP',concat('proto ',toString(Proto))), '/', toString(DstPort), if(transform(DstPort, [22,23,25,53,67,80,110,123,143,161,162,179,389,443,445,514,993,995,1194,3306,3389,5001,5060,8080,8443], ['SSH','Telnet','SMTP','DNS','DHCP','HTTP','POP3','NTP','IMAP','SNMP','SNMP trap','BGP','LDAP','HTTPS','SMB','Syslog','IMAPS','POP3S','OpenVPN','MySQL','RDP','iperf','SIP','HTTP-alt','HTTPS-alt'], '') = '', '', concat(' (', transform(DstPort, [22,23,25,53,67,80,110,123,143,161,162,179,389,443,445,514,993,995,1194,3306,3389,5001,5060,8080,8443], ['SSH','Telnet','SMTP','DNS','DHCP','HTTP','POP3','NTP','IMAP','SNMP','SNMP trap','BGP','LDAP','HTTPS','SMB','Syslog','IMAPS','POP3S','OpenVPN','MySQL','RDP','iperf','SIP','HTTP-alt','HTTPS-alt'], ''), ')'))) AS app, sum(Bytes*SamplingRate) AS bytes
     FROM default.flows WHERE TimeReceived >= greatest($__fromTime, now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AND TimeReceived <= $__toTime AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${interface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${interface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}')) AND ('${src_ip}'='' OR replaceRegexpOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '^::ffff:', '')='${src_ip}') AND ('${dst_ip}'='' OR replaceRegexpOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '^::ffff:', '')='${dst_ip}') GROUP BY conv, app)
   ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 12

panels.description: Source → destination, protocol/destination port. Average rate over the selected range (max 24 h).

defaults.noValue: No conversation data in the selected range (raw data: latest 24 h)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT arr.1 AS Protocol, round(arr.2*8/greatest(1, toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp($__fromTime))) AS Traffic, round(100*arr.2/greatest(1, t + u + i + o), 1) AS Share FROM (
     SELECT sumIf(b, c = 'TCP') AS t, sumIf(b, c = 'UDP') AS u, sumIf(b, c = 'ICMP') AS i, sumIf(b, c = 'Other') AS o FROM (
       SELECT multiIf(Proto = 6, 'TCP', Proto = 17, 'UDP', Proto = 1, 'ICMP', 'Other') AS c, sum(Bytes*SamplingRate) AS b FROM default.${res} WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${interface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${interface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}')) GROUP BY c))
   ARRAY JOIN [('TCP', t), ('UDP', u), ('ICMP', i), ('Other', o)] AS arr

defaults.noValue: No traffic in the selected scope

targets.rawSql:
SELECT app AS Port, round(bytes*8/greatest(1, toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp(greatest($__fromTime, now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR)))) AS Traffic, round(100*bytes/sum(bytes) OVER (), 1) AS Share FROM (
       SELECT concat(multiIf(Proto=6,'TCP',Proto=17,'UDP',Proto=1,'ICMP',concat('proto ',toString(Proto))), '/', toString(SrcPort)) AS app, sum(Bytes*SamplingRate) AS bytes FROM default.flows WHERE TimeReceived >= greatest($__fromTime, now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AND TimeReceived <= $__toTime AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${interface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${interface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}')) AND ('${src_ip}'='' OR replaceRegexpOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '^::ffff:', '')='${src_ip}') AND ('${dst_ip}'='' OR replaceRegexpOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '^::ffff:', '')='${dst_ip}') AND SrcPort > 0 GROUP BY app)
